scenarios.task: Scale loose limestone on the cliff face above the lake before masonry crews rig the temple overlook scaffold, reading the crew's positions below before each bar drop.
hazards: rock fall onto walkway and lake path
fall from cliff edge without anchor
steps: Barricade the base path and post a spotter with a radio
Clip into the anchored lifeline before approaching the edge
Sound suspect blocks with a scaling bar, top down
Call 'ROCK' loudly and wait for the all-clear before each drop
Sweep the shelf and bag debris into the skip
Report any block that rang hollow to the foreman

rubric.pass_if: path closed and spotter posted before first bar strike
lifeline clipped before edge approach, 100% tie-off
works top down, no blocks pried outward over crews
calls every drop and receives all-clear

scenarios.robot_role: Spot carries a lidar scan of the cliff face and ferries water up the goat path so the scaler stays clipped off longer.

scenarios.task: Replace a corroded section of storm outfall line that drains the plaza lawns into the lake, working from a partially drained coffer area.
hazards: confined wet trench with cave-in risk
unexpected water release from upslope storm line
steps: Confirm isolation: verify the upslope gate valve is shut and locked out
Test atmosphere in the coffer trench before entry
Shore the trench walls per the excavation permit
Cut out the corroded spool and measure the replacement
Bolt in the new spool with new gaskets
Crack the gate slowly to test for leaks before full flow
Backfill and restore the lakeside path surface

rubric.pass_if: lockout confirmed before cutting
shores set per permit before entry
no leak at test flow, gaskets seated square
path restored, no sediment left in the lake edge

scenarios.task: Rig a suspended scaffold at the cliff-top temple of Sybille for masonry repointing, verifying anchors in aged stone without damaging the monument.
steps: Survey the temple structure and mark sound anchor points
Install anchor bolts and pull-test each to spec
Rig the suspension cables and set counterweights
Load-test the platform with sandbags at 125%
Tag the platform with capacity and inspection card
Run a rescue-from-suspension brief with the crew before first use

rubric.pass_if: every anchor pull-tested and logged
125% test load held without movement
tool lanyards and toe boards on all sides
crew can state the suspension rescue steps

scenarios.robot_role: Go2 shuttles shackles and pins up the cliff stairs so riggers stay tied off on the platform deck.

scenarios.task: Reduce the crown of a mature plane tree shading the grove path, roping down cuts to protect pedestrians on the walk below.
hazards: limb swing into adjacent tree or path
heat and fatigue in summer work
steps: Set the drop zone and reroute path traffic with signage
Climb on harness with two tie points, set a work anchor
Rig the first cut limb with a friction saver and rope
Make the undercut, back cut, and lower each section on the rope
Work crown outward to the reduction line in the arborist plan
Chip brush and limb wood clear of the grove floor

rubric.pass_if: path closed and signed before first cut
two tie points maintained throughout
no section free-falls, cuts match reduction plan
grove floor clean, path reopened

scenarios.task: Swap failed path bollard luminaires along the commons for new LED heads, isolating each circuit at the park distribution cabinet.
hazards: trip hazard from open bollard bases on a busy path
steps: Pull the park single-line diagram and identify bollard circuits
Lock out and tag the circuit at the distribution cabinet
Verify dead at each bollard with a two-pole tester
Hand-dig around each base, watching for irrigation sleeves
Make off the new LED head, torque terminals, and reseal the gland
Energize, confirm lux levels, and reopen the path

rubric.pass_if: lockout applied and tested dead before contact
hand dig only, no irrigation damage
terminals torqued, glands sealed, IP rating kept
open bases guarded or plated at all times

scenarios.robot_role: Talos lifts bollard heads from the cart to the bases, keeping the apprentice's hands out of the pinch line.

scenarios.task: Service the rooftop air handler coils on the maintenance workshop at the park depot, including lockout of the fan and refrigerant circuit checks.
hazards: roof edge work near the cliff side of the depot
steps: Lock out the air handler disconnect and verify fan is free
Recover any refrigerant to the recovery cylinder before opening circuits
Wash coils with approved cleaner, containing runoff
Check filter racks and belts, replace as tagged
Pressurize with nitrogen and leak-test fittings
Recharge per nameplate, remove lockout, and run-test the unit

rubric.pass_if: disconnect locked before hands in the cabinet
recovered to cylinder, nitrogen test passed, no venting
coil wash runoff contained, none to roof drain
unit runs to nameplate charge and airflow

scenarios.robot_role: UR10e holds the coil wash wand at steady angle while the apprentice manages containment and gauges.
